title: Olist-QA-T: A Benchmark and Toolkit for Time-Aware Graph-RAG over Enterprise Transactions
description: Benchmark and toolkit for temporal question answering over enterprise transactional data (Olist e-commerce tables). The release contains 90 SQL- and pandas-validated temporal questions with gold time anchors, the 150 Olist-QA questions, a temporal knowledge-graph layer (interval-typed edges, 38-node time hierarchy), seven reference retrieval systems, deterministic temporal-faithfulness diagnostics, and the raw outputs of all reference runs. Code is released under MIT, data artefacts under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see DATA_LICENSE.md).
